name: Transmute Rock to Mud, Greater
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 8

Components: V, S, M (clay and water)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Area: One 5-ft. cube/level (S)

Duration: 1 round per two levels (see text)

Saving Throw: See text; Spell Resistance: no

This spell is similar to transmute rock to mud, but will also affect cut or worked stone. When the spell duration ends, affected objects return to stone. Creatures in the mud get a Reflex save to avoid getting stuck when the mud returns to stone.
